contea di ritrovamento: Oxfordshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

A Roman copper alloy coin: sestersius of Antoninus Pius (AD138-161). Mint of Rome, reverse: S C; (probably) Class: BMC IV, pl 28, c.f. no. 7. Obverse: Laureate head right Obverse inscription: ANTONINVS AVG PI[.....] Reverse: SC Concordia standing left, holding Victory and standard. Dimensions: diameter: 29.92mm; weight: 20.50g. Identification by Sam Moorhead, PAS Finds Advisor Iron Age and Roman coins
